definitions.explanation: The area just at or outside the front door of a house, where visitors are dealt with without being asked in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{玄関先|げんかんさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I leave the package at the front door.

examples.japanese: {玄関先|げんかんさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
{玄関先|げんかんさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{失礼|しつれい}します⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上|あ}がら→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Saying she would just say goodbye at the door, the visitor left without coming in.

notes:
⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ here means "the area just beyond". Talking at the {玄関先|げんかんさき} means the visitor is not invited up into the house.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {玄関先|げんかんさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{失礼|しつれい}します: I'll just say this at the door (a polite way to decline coming in)
- {玄関先|げんかんさき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}き→置く：01092_oku⟧{配|はい}する: to leave a delivery at the door
- {玄関先|げんかんさき}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧: to see someone to the door

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧: the entrance hall itself, where shoes are taken off
